Support

Help with the Phraselet Chrome extension

Contact

Email mpbagwell.dev@gmail.com with a short description of what happened and the version of Chrome you're using. Do not include private saved phrases unless they are necessary to explain the issue.

Before contacting support

  • Confirm Phraselet is enabled at chrome://extensions.
  • Reload the page where you are trying to save a phrase.
  • Check or change the shortcut at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.
  • Remember that Chrome's own pages and some protected pages do not allow extensions to read selections.

Back up your library

Use Export in the Phraselet popup to download a JSON backup. Keep that file somewhere you trust before clearing extension data or reinstalling Chrome.

Privacy

Phraselet's public version stores its library locally and does not send it to a support server. Read the complete privacy policy.
